description: Write a release note under exact line, length and vocabulary constraints.
prompt:
Write a release note for {component} version {version}.

Format rules, all of which are checked mechanically:

- Line 1 must be exactly: {header}
- Then exactly {bullet_count} bullet lines, each starting with "- "
- The whole note must be at most {max_chars} characters and at least 80
- The word "{banned_word}" must not appear, in any capitalisation
- No blank lines, no trailing commentary, no code fence

Output the note and nothing else.
